candidate: H47 shared low-bit complete-neuron functional manifold

parent_evidence.dense_path_terminal: H46 exact-byte global sign plus private-microcore union
parent_evidence.h46_conclusion: The exact one-percent dense-path union captures 7.83--8.32 percent of weighted top-16 state energy, but 96--98 percent of the gain comes from one target-aligned global sign atom; private continuous cores add only 0.153--0.163 percentage points and weakest-PC capture remains below 0.01 percent.
parent_evidence.causal_transition: Stop reconstructing the near-Haar dense optimizer path. Test a looser function quotient while preserving each GELU detector and residual-write vector as one indivisible nonlinear atom.

scientific_question: Can one shared bank of complete GELU neurons, stored in less than one percent of the dense FP16 MLP matrix bytes and routed by layer-local gains, reproduce every terminal dense-parent MLP function and input Jacobian on disjoint residual-stream samples?

frozen_teacher.teacher_identity_policy: Hash the terminal snapshot, its embedded run identity and exact tensor inventory, dataset manifest, source config, and exact model parameter inventory at runtime. Abort on any mismatch or nonzero MLP bias.

frozen_function_inventory.collection: Stream deterministic validation batches through the sealed terminal dense parent and retain only the current layer's MLP input, teacher output, and deterministic JVP directions during fitting/evaluation.
frozen_function_inventory.persistent_activation_cache: none in the deployed checkpoint; analysis tensors may be streamed or written only to the result directory and must be byte-accounted

frozen_representation.atom_policy: Detector u_j and write v_j are always initialized, optimized, quantized, stored, and evaluated as a paired complete neuron. Matrix-wise reassignment is forbidden.
frozen_representation.atom_codes: symmetric signed int4 with integer range [-7,7]
frozen_representation.scale_policy: one FP16 max-absolute/7 scale for each detector vector and one for each write vector
frozen_representation.layer_routing: one FP16 multiplicative output gain g_lj for every layer and shared atom
frozen_representation.quantized_forward: straight-through round-and-clip during fitting; exact dequantized int4 codes and stored FP16 scales/gains for terminal evaluation

exact_deployment_accounting.temporary_training_state_policy: Report FP32 master atoms, gradients, Adam first/second moments, routing gradients, activation tensors, and peak CUDA bytes separately. None may be counted as deployed compression.
exact_deployment_accounting.cached_inference_policy: If dequantized FP16 U/V are cached, report the additional 4,365,312 bytes and do not call that cache part of the compact checkpoint. Only one shared cache is allowed across all layers.

teacher_derived_initialization.score: For dense teacher neuron j in layer l, e_lj=||GELU(X_train,l u_lj)||_2 ||v_lj||_2.
teacher_derived_initialization.balanced_quota: Select the top 119 scored complete neurons from layers 0--4 and top 118 from layers 5--11, totaling exactly 1421 atoms.
teacher_derived_initialization.atom_initialization: Copy each selected teacher detector row and its paired c_proj column together into the shared master bank.
teacher_derived_initialization.gain_initialization: Set gain one only at the selected atom's source layer and zero at every other layer.
teacher_derived_initialization.reason: Balanced seeding prevents a high-energy layer from monopolizing the shared bank, gives an exact functional interpretation at initialization, and does not store an empirical trajectory/PCA basis.

fit.objective: Mean over layers of relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact input-JVP MSE, evaluated through the int4 STE bank. Denominators are stop-gradient teacher energies per layer and split.
fit.optimizer: AdamW on FP32 master u/v atoms and FP32 layer gains
fit.layer_schedule: deterministic round-robin over all 12 layers, 128 updates per layer
fit.quantization: STE int4 on every fit forward; terminal codes are frozen by exact round-and-clip and gains are cast to FP16 before final metrics

controls.random_shared: Same 1421-atom int4 bank and layer-gain bytes, deterministic Gaussian paired atoms, gains fit under the identical protocol while atoms stay fixed.
controls.private_narrow: Same total int4 atom bytes divided as 119 private complete atoms in layers 0--4 and 118 in layers 5--11; no cross-layer sharing; private atoms and gains fit under the identical protocol.
controls.unquantized_architecture: Terminal FP32 master shared bank evaluated before int4 to attribute any miss to sharing/width versus quantization. This is an over-budget diagnostic only.
controls.dense_teacher: Exact teacher output/JVP identity and numerical self-check.

metrics.control_margins: Report learned-minus-random and learned-minus-private-narrow for every metric; absolute gates, not control wins, determine promotion.

systems_gate.watchdog_policy: terminal/error callback only for a run projected to finish within two hours; 90-minute resettable heartbeat only if it runs longer
systems_gate.candidate_kernel: benchmark cached FP16 dequantization and direct candidate MLP against the exact dense 3072-wide teacher shape
systems_gate.dequantization: one shared-bank refresh cost reported separately from token-time MLP latency

promotion: Only if every representation and systems gate passes, implement the identical compact-native module and exact-config performance-gate one 124M 0.5TPP causal acquisition before any CE conclusion.
failure: If any required layer fails, close shared complete-neuron amortization at this exact one-percent byte budget. Attribute failure among quantization, shared-bank capacity, and function/JVP mismatch using only the frozen controls; do not sweep width, bits, routing, seeds, losses, or optimizer.
forbidden: weight-PCA or residual-state recovery as a promotion metric
a dense per-layer teacher shadow, stored empirical basis, or hidden dequantized checkpoint
width, bitwidth, layer, seed, loss-weight, optimizer, or initialization sweep
CE, larger-model, or longer-horizon training before every functional/JVP and systems gate passes
